answer: Count the cost first. Price each identity at the work needed to replicate it, convert every payout into a stream vesting over 30 days, and rotate the auditor pool so no reviewer sees the same submitter twice in a week. A farm must then fund 30 days of output per clone and survive reviewers it cannot pre-select. That is a plume of sunk cost on a glacier of waiting, and the ridge of profit never arrives.
